card.statement:
Fix $k\in\mathbb Z$. Then for any $P\in \mathcal N_q^-$, there exists unique

$$
Q(a,(q_k)),R(c,(r_l))\in \mathcal N_q^-,\quad a,b\in \mathbb Z , (q_l),(r_m)\in\mathbb N^{\mathbb N^*},
$$

such that

\begin{equation}
[x^-(k),P]=\sum \frac{ a_+^{(q_l)}K^a Q(a,(q_l))}{q-q^{-1}}+\sum \frac{a_-^{(r_m)}K^b\ R(b,(r_m))}{q-q^{-1}}.
\end{equation}
card.label: Lemma 5

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules and Kashiwara algebras for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
